review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical benchmark input, without asserting a human Decision; the empty decision-input fingerprint is therefore consistent. This does not relax the paired B scenario's requirement that an unresolved material DEC-001 block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, verification dependency, repository identity and base commit align. The supplied source establishes core/api.ts as the shared stringbool implementation, including existing case normalization, default vocabularies and truthy-first parsing. Construction-time overlap rejection can be scoped there, with classic and new mini regressions in the exact allowed files. Forwarders and declaration consumers appropriately remain inspection owners, and the build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Acceptance covers overlap boundaries without trimming and preserves non-overlap, inference and codec compatibility; only the selected option is required. Runtime and compiler checks are distinguished in the PRD and supported by the supplied configuration. Assignment expectations are supported by active project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change for both roles and testing.verification for the independent verifier; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. A separate configured reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, evaluation source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and policy. The documented source-digest domains and PRD trim normalization explain the differing manifest and original/saved PRD fingerprints. Historical operations are retained as old-version provenance, not treated as candidates or fresh evidence on this bundle. On the supplied frozen inputs, ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. This approval is a documentary review only: I used no tools, executed no code, independently recomputed no digests, and supplied no human attestation.
